name: cartographer
description: Codebase Cartographer: a Claude Code plugin/skill that designs and generates a codebase's organizational documentation system (map, glossary, conventions, roadmap, CLAUDE.md).

plugins.name: cartographer
plugins.description: Documents a codebase: an INDEX map of entry points, modules, subsystems and data flow, a CLAUDE.md "Where things are" block, a GLOSSARY, a ROADMAP, and a CONVENTIONS guide. Reads files before writing, verifies every cited path, and won't overwrite docs you already have.
